title: Developer Marketing Quickstart
audience: Developers who need a simple starting point for customer acquisition.
shortDescription: Build a minimum viable customer-acquisition system in seven days.
coreOutcome: Define who to target, what to offer, where to find buyers, and what to measure.
problem: Marketing feels like disconnected advice instead of a process you can execute.
situation: You can build useful things, but customer acquisition still starts from a blank page.
commonFailure: Collecting tactics without choosing a market, offer, message, channel, and measurement loop creates activity without a system.
methodology: Build the smallest complete acquisition loop, run it, measure it, and improve the weakest step.
capabilities: Choose a specific audience and problem
Connect an offer to a practical message
Define the next action and measurement
whoItsFor: Freelancers, consultants, and SaaS builders beginning to systematize marketing
whoItsNotFor: Anyone looking for guaranteed customers or a passive acquisition shortcut

faqs.question: Why is the form not available yet?
